title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

errors: Redundancy in the (e0, r'0) and (e0, r'1) boxes. Introduce a = y x y^{-1} x with x = e0, y = r'0. The relation y = (y x y^{-1} x)^2 becomes y = a^2, i.e. a = a^2 x a^{-2} x, i.e. x a x = a^2, which is the braid relation. So <x, y | y = (y x y^{-1} x)^2> already presents B_3, and [y^3, x] = 1 is a consequence. Grothendieck's NB seems to sense that one relation suffices.

If the NB's single equation is meant as just the commutator [r'0(e0) e0 r'0, e0] = 1, it cannot suffice. Z^2 with x, y independent satisfies the commutator but not y = (y(x)x)^2, which would force y = 4x. The reading is ambiguous: the relation can only be rewritten as a commutator of the cube once y = a^2 is known.

The label j'0 is used for two different cases, (e0, r'0) and (e0, r'1). The first is probably i'0, as the closing line 'relations i'0' suggests. Cross-references of the form 'relations h1' should probably read h'1.

ideas.what: Systematic enumeration of generating pairs of B_3 (Dehn twists, the element of order 4 and the elements of order 3 mod the centre, and their squares), each with an explicit presentation
ideas.modern_name: Presentations of B_3 = mapping class group of the one-holed torus; Tietze transformations
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Artin 1925; B_3 = <x,y | x^2 = y^3>, Serre's Trees for SL(2,Z))
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses the Teichmüller tower and the genus-1 building block only qualitatively

ideas.what: One-relator presentations such as <e0, r1 | r1 e0 r1^{-1} e0 r1 = 1> and <e0, r'0 | r'0 = (r'0 e0 r'0^{-1} e0)^2>
ideas.modern_name: One-relator presentations of the trefoil knot group / B_3

ideas.what: Use of the centrality of s^2 and r^3 to replace conjugation by r'0 = r0^{-2} with conjugation by r0
ideas.modern_name: Centre of B_3 generated by the full twist Delta^2

deep.surprise_reason: This is careful bookkeeping of standard presentations of B_3 (the one-holed torus mapping class group) as groundwork for the Teichmüller tower. All computations are routine Tietze manipulations, and only minor redundancy and ambiguity issues appear.
transcription_corrections: Top case label is likely (i'0) rather than (j'0); the image shows a different, darkened letter, and the last case refers back to 'relations i'0'.
In the NB, 'obvi.cede' is illegible; it plausibly reads 'abrégée' or 'équivalente', i.e. '...à la seule équation [abrégée?] suivante'.
For the h'0 case the closing reference likely reads 'relations h'1', not 'h1'.
In the NB the arrow indicates that the braced element r'0(e0) e0 r'0 equals (r'0(e0) e0)^3; the transcription's 'qui implique ... donc' sequence garbles this.
On the previous page, 'rho0^{-3} = sigma^{-2}' should mathematically be rho0^{-3} = (e1 e0)^3 = sigma^2.
